description: This file contains a script to migrate item tax data into a dedicated 'Item Tax Template' and update related references across different document types in the ERPNext system. It includes functions to generate tax templates based on existing tax rates, standardize account types, and assign these templates to items and transactions as part of a database migration or system upgrade.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Main function to reload data, create or update item tax templates, and assign them to items and transactions as part of the migration process.

methods.name: get_item_tax_template(item_tax_templates, item_tax_map, item_code, parenttype=None, parent=None, tax_types=None)
methods.description: Generates or fetches an item tax template based on a provided tax map, creating new account entries if necessary, and avoiding duplicate templates.

methods.name: get_company(company_abbr, parenttype=None, parent=None)
methods.description: Retrieves the company name based on abbreviation or parent document, defaulting to a single registered company if only one exists.
